content: Unused laptops may be returned within 30 days of delivery. Keep the receipt and original packaging.
Standard shipping costs 5 dollars and takes 3 business days. Orders over 100 dollars get free standard shipping.
TechMart headphones include a 24 month warranty covering manufacturing defects. Accidental damage is excluded.
TechMart support opens Monday through Friday from 09:00 to 17:00 UTC. Contact support@techmart.example.
TechMart accepts Visa and Mastercard. Bank transfers require 2 business days to clear. Cash on delivery is unavailable.
TechMart collection orders are held for 5 calendar days. Bring a photo ID and order number to collect.
TechMart orders can be cancelled within 2 hours of payment if not dispatched. Contact support with the order number.
TechMart students receive a 10 percent discount after student ID verification. Discounts cannot be combined.
TechMart diagnostic checks cost 20 dollars. Authorized repairs take 7 business days after approval.
TechMart gift cards expire after 12 months. Lost cards cannot be replaced. Gift cards cannot be exchanged for cash.
SkillHub course fees are refundable within 7 days of enrollment if less than 20 percent of lessons have been completed.
SkillHub certificates require an 80 percent assessment score and completion of all lessons. Certificates appear within 48 hours.
SkillHub mentoring sessions last 45 minutes. Book sessions at least 24 hours in advance through the learner dashboard.
SkillHub purchased course materials remain accessible for 18 months from enrollment. Downloads are limited to supplied worksheets.
SkillHub live cohorts start on the first Monday of each month. Each cohort has at most 25 learners.
SkillHub Python Foundations requires no prior programming experience. A laptop with 8 GB RAM and internet access is recommended.
SkillHub learner support is available every day from 08:00 to 20:00 UTC at learners@skillhub.example.
SkillHub team plans require at least 5 seats. Team managers can transfer an unused seat before a learner starts lessons.
SkillHub live sessions can be rescheduled up to 12 hours before the scheduled start. One free change is allowed per booking.
SkillHub assignment feedback arrives within 3 business days. Each assignment allows 2 resubmissions after feedback.
